scope: direct finite-scalar/full-analytic-vector numerical comparison; no released-interpolant, geometry-convergence or absolute MC guarantee

analytic_box.qualification: analytic enclosure in exact arithmetic; float64 FFT/kernel evaluations padded heuristically, not interval arithmetic; finite analytic-normalized kernel only, NUFFT error separate

root_bound.qualification: PSD/trace enclosure in exact arithmetic; float64 padded evaluations, not interval arithmetic; numerical action errors separate

root_polynomial.qualification: exact-arithmetic interpolation bound; excludes coefficient rounding, matrix-action error and recurrence roundoff

next_view.score_convention: numeric trapezoidal integral of 5%-95% uncertainty mask

gpu_process_audit.qualification: Periodic process samples can miss short-lived GPU work; no other job was stopped.
